description: B_lin and B_log (signed and abs readings) for D, T, 3He, 4He across the faithful positive Markov window z in [0, h], h = q - 1/q, with the trace at parameter z carried as an explicit polynomial in z (Ocneanu closed-form weight x characters over all p(3A) partitions, borromean words, proton q0). Locates the in-window roots of tr(W_atom), tr(W_free) and tests where each functional is defined. EXPLORATORY: not wired; no AME comparison; no selection by symmetry (bean qou-wktw).

data.weight_family: ocneanu_markov_weight(q, z) — QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuWeight; NOT y_lambda except at z = z_D

neutron.root_in_window_closed_form: P_n(z) = K(1 - z^2) + B z; roots (B ± sqrt(B^2 + 4K^2))/(2K), product −1. In-window root at q0 is the '−' branch; K < 0 iff q^3 − q − 1 < 0 (q below the plastic number), as at q0

data.structure_note: Measured (coefficient dev <= 1e-50): tr_z(W_atom) = Π_bonds(z + d_k) · P_p(z)^Z · P_n(z)^N and tr_z(W_free) = P_p^Z P_n^N. Hence B_log(z) = −E_0 Σ_bonds log(z + d_k): the nucleon polynomials cancel identically and the log functional sees ONLY the bond letters; B_lin = Q_β P_p^Z P_n^N (1 − Π(z+d_k)) keeps them, and since |Π(z+d_k)| < 1 on the window its sign is sign(P_p^Z P_n^N). Split-braid multiplicativity is not proved here (bean qou-5zl1).
